title: published-tree blob
property: parsePublication never hangs (per-case time recorded, watchdog in the runner), accepts every honest blob of the documented layout (n <= 64 leaves, depth 32, r <= 16 revocations), and when it returns, the statement's root equals an independent Merkle rebuild of the returned leaves at the blob's depth and revRoot equals the returned revocation tree's root. Throwing on a malformed blob is allowed (any error class is recorded). Blobs that differ from the canonical encoding of what they parse to (trailing bytes, a depth other than 32, a leaf >= p, another statement spelling) are recorded as observations
